description: Count a cohort without saving anything (nothing appears in the console): run up to 10 segment rules now and get the counts (matched, opted out, eligible to text) and the first contacts. Examples: replied in the last 7 days (last_reply_at after 7d); got a batch and did not reply (batch sent, and batch replied with is_not); started checkout but never purchased (event exists, event not_exists); VIPs not texted in 30 days. Same rule fields as a saved segment. Everyone eligible to text: one rule, status is subscribed.

limit.description: How many matching contacts to return

match.description: all: a contact must match every rule. any: at least one rule

rules.description: Up to 10 rules that decide who matches

field.description: Attributes: tag, the name and profile fields, source, field (a custom field), import, status (opt-out), topic, list (in a static list), created_at. Behaviour: last_message_at (last text either way), last_reply_at (last text from them), batch (what happened to them in one batch), event (a tracked event; the newest 20,000 events are searched).

key.description: The custom field name (field), topic id (topic), batch id (batch), or event name (event)

op.description: Text fields take is / is_not / contains / not_contains / exists / not_exists; tag takes is / is_not / exists / not_exists; status, topic, import, batch and list take is / is_not; created_at takes before / after; last_message_at, last_reply_at and event take after (at or after the time), before (it happened, and the last time was before it), exists (ever) and not_exists (never). Comparisons ignore case.

value.description: status: subscribed or opted_out. topic: subscribed or unsubscribed. import: an import id. list: a list id (lst_...). batch: included, sent, failed, skipped or replied (sent, then texted the batch's number after it was created). Times (created_at, last_message_at, last_reply_at, event): an ISO date, or a window back from now such as 7d or 24h, read each time the segment is used.

topic_id.description: Topic id or name: eligible also removes contacts unsubscribed from it

name: query_audience
title: Query audience
